text:
Maria: Quick proposal: rollout plan for dedicated-pool autoscaler v2. want a staged canary with SLO tracing and cost-gates before we expand. feedback?

Chris: sounds good. can you sketch the stages and failure gates?

Aisha: main worry is small-tenant headroom oscillation -> p95 spikes. also prewarm churn.

Maria: draft stages:
1) canary: deploy to two low-traffic tenants for 2h (tenant-canary-1, tenant-canary-2)
2) collect per-tenant: p50/p95/p99 latencies, error-rate, evictions, avg_gpu_util, wasted_prewarms
3) tag traces with rollout=dedicated-autoscaler-v2 and rollout.stage=canary to correlate
4) evaluation gates (canary): if (p95 > baseline * 1.15) for 10m OR (evictions > baseline * 3) in 1h -> trigger rollback
5) if canary stable -> expand to 20% of pools over 24h (stage=partial)
6) full after 48h stable (stage=full)

Ben: add a cost safety net: if billing_inference_cost spikes > $200 in 30m for the canary tag -> pause and notify finance.

Olga: operator/runbook notes please:
- manual rollback CLI:
  redwoodctl rollout cancel --name dedicated-autoscaler-v2 --force
- kubectl patch to force v1 env (example):
```
kubectl -n redwood patch deployment pool-orch --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/0/value","value":"v1"}]'
```
- after rollback: tag traces with rollback=true, open incident thread in #incidents, and set trace retention to 7d for these tags

Maria: for metric queries we'll rely on traces + Prometheus. example queries: 
- p95 (approx): histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_bucket{tag=~"rollout.*"}[5m])) by (le))
- evictions: increase(dedicated_pool_evictions_total{pool=~"tenant.*",rollout!~""}[1h])
- avg GPU util per tenant: avg_over_time(gpu_utilization_percent{pool=~"tenant.*",rollout="dedicated-autoscaler-v2"}[30m])

Chris: operator rollback semantics? immediate or require repeated violations?

Maria: operator policy suggestion: require 2 consecutive eval windows (eval window = 5m) exceeding a gate before auto-rollback. reduces noisy flips.

Aisha: i'll build a dashboard panel with rollout tag filters and the gate thresholds. will add quick links for rollback commands and trace view.

Ben: also want a pause-if-underutilized gate: if avg_gpu_util < baseline * 0.6 for 30m -> pause widening. prevents underutilization debt.

Olga: add rollout.stage tag (canary|partial|full) to traces and metrics so filtering is simpler. also include trace ids in lease/revoke logs.

Maria: adding verbose prewarm logs for canary via configmap override: 
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
data:
  PREWARM_LOG_LEVEL: debug
```

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for dedicated-autoscaler-v2 on tenants: tenant-canary-1, tenant-canary-2

Chris: who is on-watch for first 2h window? I can take the first hour.

Aisha: I can take the second hour and watch traces + dashboard.

Ben: small nit on thresholds: earlier we debated 1.2 for p95. agree to be conservative for canary with 1.15.

Maria: alerts we'll create for rollout: 
- p95 > baseline*1.15 sustained 10m -> page oncall
- evictions rate > baseline*2 in 30m -> pager
- avg_gpu_util < baseline*0.6 for 30m -> non-pager notify #eng-runtime
- billing_inference_cost increase > $200 in 30m -> notify finance@redwood and pause expansion

deploy-bot: Canary metrics collection in progress. verbose logs enabled for canary tenants.

Aisha: 30m check-in: p95 +2% vs baseline, p50 flat, evictions 0, avg_gpu_util +4%, wasted_prewarms minimal. No gates breached so far.

Maria: good. let's keep watch. when we widen, update this thread with who performed expansion and the new rollout.stage tag.

Olga: follow-up: ensure the operator emits a metric for "rollback_reason" label and include it in traces when rollback happens.

Chris: add an automatic short-circuit: if a gate trips twice within first 20m -> immediate rollback and mark canary failed. otherwise operator follows 2-eval policy.

Maria: noted. adding to the runbook. also planning a 30m retro after full rollout to capture tuning adjustments.

Ben: :thumbsup: I'll review rollback logic in operator today and flag any corner cases.

Aisha: dashboard (canary view): https://console.redwood/p/dedicated-autoscaler/rollout?tag=rollout%3Ddedicated-autoscaler-v2&stage=canary

deploy-bot: Canary stable after 2h. no gates tripped. ready to widen to 20% per plan.
